args: In gpac/src/isomedia/box_code_meta.c, what is the safest project-idiomatic fix for iloc_box_read around lines 314-343, considering GF_ItemLocationEntry allocation, gf_list_new failures, gf_list_add failures, and ISOM_DECREASE_SIZE's early-return behavior? Please identify return types/semantics of gf_list_add and whether GF_SAFEALLOC is available in this file/version.

The sanitizer crash occurs because iloc_box_read allocates GF_ItemLocationEntry with gf_malloc at gpac/src/isomedia/box_code_meta.c:315 and publishes it to ptr->location_entries at line 318 before extent_entries is initialized at line 342. A truncated iloc triggers ISOM_DECREASE_SIZE at line 320, then box cleanup invokes iloc_entry_del and gf_list_count on an indeterminate extent_entries pointer. I am considering zero-initialization and eagerly creating extent_entries before publishing, plus handling allocation/list insertion failures. No source changes have yet been made.
